name: Mira Vey
title: The Twin Ember
speciality: Careful mana management and elemental spellcraft, visually expressed through simultaneous frost and fire.

specialPowers.name: Spellweaving
specialPowers.description: Begin each fight with 3 additional mana. Spell items spend available mana in backpack reading order. Unused mana carries between turns within the fight without a cap; it is not passive regeneration.
specialPowers.visualDirection: Two open palms supporting distinct elemental spells, with a restrained violet mana aura.

specialPowers.name: Ember spell
specialPowers.description: Ember Grimoire costs 3 mana to deal 10 direct damage and apply 2 burn. This is an equipped item's effect, not an additional innate class ability.
specialPowers.visualDirection: A compact orange-red flame with a pale gold heart above the viewer-right palm.

specialPowers.name: Frost spell
specialPowers.description: Frost Wand costs 2 mana to deal 8 direct damage and reduce each enemy strike by 2 that turn. It is a possible acquired item, not part of the current starting loadout.
specialPowers.visualDirection: A faceted icy core and small curl of frost above the viewer-left palm. The idle illustration can show this established elemental identity independently of the current equipped loadout.

weapons.name: Fire and frost manifestations
weapons.relationship: Signature visual expression of the approved direction; item effects depend on the equipped inventory.
weapons.description: Both hands open, palms facing upward and gently forward. Each compact spell hovers just above its palm with a small air gap; fingers, wrists and face remain visible.

weapons.name: Ember Grimoire
weapons.relationship: Starting spell item; stowed rather than held in the default two-palm design.
weapons.description: A small dark-bound book with a restrained ember seal, optionally attached at the belt. It must not compete with the hands or enter the head portrait.

weapons.name: Frost Wand
weapons.relationship: Optional acquired item; not held in the default idle illustration.
weapons.description: When specifically requested in a variant, use a slender dark shaft with a clear ice-colored focus; preserve Mira's two-element identity.

itemAliasNotes: Frost Wand is not a starter item. The subtle aura is a visual identity feature and grants no separate buff.

bio.summary: A young spellwright who believes fire and frost are two ways of asking the same question.
bio.origin: Mira trained in a modest workshop that repaired enchanted lamps, cold-storage seals and unreliable household charms. During an experiment to make one focus handle both heat and cold, she discovered that the workshop's oldest crystal answered to a pulse deep beneath the city. She follows that pulse into the dungeon, recording what she learns rather than trusting the academy's old warnings.
bio.motivation: Understand the buried mana source and build magic that ordinary people can use safely.
bio.mannerisms: Tests an idea with one small flame and one tiny ice crystal; speaks her measurements under her breath when concentrating.
bio.voice: Clear and thoughtful, becoming quick and animated when a discovery surprises her.
bio.quote: A little heat. A little patience. Watch.

physicalAppearance.build: Slender adult proportions with natural shoulders, waist, hips and limbs. Elegance comes from posture and cloth volume, not an oversized head, exaggerated curves or stretched legs.
physicalAppearance.silhouette: Uncovered silver-haired head above a fitted indigo bodice, plum shoulder mantle and layered split robes; both forearms extend gently forward and outward to show the two spells.
physicalAppearance.headTreatment: Clear exposed anime-inspired human face; no elf ears and no tall pointed hat.
physicalAppearance.headShape: Softly angular oval face, gently defined cheekbones, a small proportionate chin and a visible neck above the high collar.
physicalAppearance.face: Fair skin with warm peach undertones, clean simplified facial planes, small straight nose and a restrained closed mouth. Avoid cold gray skin caused by overusing the hair palette.
physicalAppearance.eyes: Blue-violet irises, deliberate dark upper lids, coherent three-quarter gaze and expressive but proportionate anime eye shapes.
physicalAppearance.hair: Silver, chin-to-shoulder-length layered hair with faint lavender shadows; a side-swept fringe frames the forehead, one side tucked back. Broad connected locks and a few purposeful light clusters preserve volume.
physicalAppearance.headwear: No head covering in the default design. Any hood is folded behind the neck and must not obscure the face.
physicalAppearance.upperBody: Fitted high-neck indigo bodice, shaped shoulders, plum short mantle, restrained antique-silver clasps and narrow pale trim. A small violet mana gem sits at the collar.
physicalAppearance.lowerBody: Overlapping indigo and plum robe panels form an open asymmetric overskirt. Dark fitted leggings and practical dark calf-height boots remain visible beneath it; cloth folds are broad and readable.
physicalAppearance.hands: Both bare hands are visible with clear wrists, thumbs and softly curved fingers. Palms turn upward at waist-to-lower-chest height; forearms are gently forward, not rigidly extended sideways.
physicalAppearance.cloak: A short shoulder mantle above flowing split robe panels, avoiding a solid cone-shaped robe that hides all leg structure.
distinguishingFeatures: Silver hair with lavender shadow planes
Frost on the viewer's left and fire on the viewer's right
Small violet collar gem and subtle mana wisps
physicalAppearance.expressionAndBearing: Focused and self-assured, relaxed enough to suggest she controls both spells without strain.
physicalAppearance.effects: Compact frost crystal/curl above the viewer-left palm and orange-red flame above the viewer-right palm. Two or three subdued blue-violet wisps near the outer lower torso; no enclosing bubble, huge halo or particle shower. Local light may touch the nearest hands and cuffs.
physicalAppearance.portraitDirection: Center the silver-haired head with complete locks and chin; retain the indigo collar, plum mantle and small collar gem when space permits. Exclude hands, fire, ice, aura fragments and book/wand edges. Keep warm facial colors and readable eyes at 64 x 64.
avoid: Tall wizard hat hiding the hair
Spells obscuring her face or fingers
A staff occupying either open palm
A large aura ring or constant glitter

assetReferences.appearanceBasis: User-requested young woman with frost, fire and subtle mana aura, following mage v2. New name and biography are authored for this catalog.

identityStatus: Newly authored character profile; names and lore have not yet been individually reviewed.

body.measurement: Head/headwear to soles; exclude held equipment, detached effects and transparent padding.

portrait.source: Original generated concept or another sufficiently detailed identity source, independently framed and cleaned.
portrait.framing: Optically center the visible head; preserve complete hair/headwear and chin, with modest neck and shoulder context.
portrait.obstructions: Remove incidental weapons, quivers, spell fragments and other obstructions; reconstruct hidden head details. Retain intentional helmets and masks.

generation.pose: Upright, relaxed and alert, slight three-quarter turn toward the viewer's right, grounded feet and a natural weight shift.
generation.rendering: Original fantasy pixel art with cohesive adult proportions, deliberate connected clusters, sculpted material planes, selective highlights and restrained texture. Exposed faces use intentional anime-inspired eye/lid, nose and mouth shapes.
deliverables: Separate 64 x 64 portrait spritex authoring JSON
generation.review: Inspect body, grip and portrait at native/intended display size. Technical validation is separate from user approval.
